X1.evidence: Sec. 4.3, 5.5, and Supplement A: models varied by hidden size, training corpus size, and five training subsets; template-generated sentences included variable noun number, modifiers, and adverb position. These factors were not reported as a full factorial crossing of model and wording.

X2.evidence: Sec. 5.5, Fig. 5 and Table 3: mixed-effects terms and a reported interaction quantify how hidden-unit size and corpus size relate to similarity distance.

X3.evidence: Supplement C.5, Table 3: the mixed-effects model includes a hidden-unit-size by corpus-size interaction.

notes: The reported M x M interaction is between two model-configuration dimensions (hidden size and training corpus size), both coded as model variation.
